epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase supported distinct entity types in the catalog from 1 to 3
epics.tocConstraintRef: Lack of distinct entity models blocking protocol and data management
requirements: R1: Validate and store protocol-specific attributes when adding a protocol
R2: Validate and store data-specific structures when uploading epidemiological data

slices.title: Patch generic materials service to support distinct protocols and data
slices.jtbd: When implementing distinct entities for this epic, I want to patch the existing material logic to branch and validate specific attributes for protocols and data, so that they are managed accurately.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user submits protocol details, When the system processes the request, Then protocol-specific attributes are validated, stored, and verified via tests.
Given a user submits epidemiological data, When the system processes the request, Then data-specific structures are validated, stored, and verified via tests.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Generic backend service discarding specific attributes
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce entity attribute loss from 100% to 0% during storage

epics.title: Protocol and Material Versioning
epics.jtbd: When an epidemiological protocol or material description is updated, I want the system to track previous versions and maintain a revision history, so that I can audit changes and revert to older versions to ensure clinical compliance and procedural safety.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase version auditability from 0% to 100% of material updates
epics.tocConstraintRef: Lack of version control preventing compliance audits
requirements: R1: Track previous versions and maintain revision history upon editing and saving a protocol or material
R2: Provide a historical revision list with the ability to view the content of any past version

slices.title: Implement version history tracking for materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing versioning for this epic, I want to patch the existing update flows to record historical revisions, so that the history feature can display past versions.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a protocol is updated, When the save operation completes, Then the previous state is recorded in the revision history, and integration tests verify the version was tracked.
Given a protocol with history, When a user views its detailed page, Then past versions can be retrieved with timestamps and authors.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Backend not retaining historical states of entities during updates
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce untracked material changes from 100% to 0%

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Improve local deployment health check success rate from 0% to 100%
requirements: R1: Fix the underlying issue preventing the application from launching or passing its health check

slices.title: Resolve local deployment runtime health check failure
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to resolve the launch configuration or dependency causing the failure, so that the product launches successfully and passes health checks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application stack is started, When the launch sequence completes, Then the process remains running without crashing, and automated tests confirm successful startup.
Given the application is running, When the health check endpoint is queried, Then it returns a 200 OK healthy status.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Broken local runtime preventing execution and verification
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce runtime crash rate from 100% to 0%
